assessed_concepts: Original source task: Construct a query to find ClientName and ContactNumber for projects managed by Sehee Choi that are High priority.
Tables Client(ClientID,ClientName,ContactNumber) and Job(JobID,ClientID,LeadName,Priority) are provided

markscheme.marking_summary:
One solution:
SELECT c.ClientName, c.ContactNumber
FROM Client AS c JOIN Job AS j ON c.ClientID=j.ClientID
WHERE j.LeadName='Mira Sen' AND j.Priority='High';
